prompt: Addition of HBr to propene in the presence of peroxides (ROOR). Draw the major product.

traps.note: Peroxides flip to anti-Markovnikov via radical mechanism; without peroxides, Markovnikov applies.

explanation: Peroxides initiate a radical chain. Br• adds to the less-substituted carbon (gives the more stable 2° C radical intermediate), then abstracts H from HBr → anti-Markovnikov product. Note: only HBr shows this effect, not HCl or HI.
